# ADR-0001: Adopt deterministic structural parsing

## Status
Accepted

## Context
Natural language has no free deterministic parser, unlike code.

## Decision
WHY: We build a deterministic structural spine (L0/L1) before any model runs, so
the graph is reproducible and always shippable without an LLM.

## Consequences
Same corpus + same version MUST produce a byte-identical graph.json.
